title: HOMECHEFF_INVENTORY_END_TO_END
PREVIOUS_FALSE_PASS_REASON: Prior INVENTORY=PASS certified PATCH omit-vs-zero semantics and DB writes, not the owner UI. MarketplaceOfferForm hid stock for CREATE without whitelist specs and for DESIGN, then saved stock:0, wiping remaining inventory on existing-item edit.

CURRENT_PRODUCTION_REPRODUCTION.STOCK_FIELD_VISIBLE: FAIL before fix for CREATE without PHYSICAL_CREATE_TAXONOMY_IDS and all DESIGN; PASS after for CREATE/GROW/DESIGN/workshops
CURRENT_PRODUCTION_REPRODUCTION.STOCK_FIELD_EDITABLE: FAIL before when field hidden; PASS after
CURRENT_PRODUCTION_REPRODUCTION.STOCK_FIELD_SAVEABLE: FAIL before: hidden path sent stock:0; PASS after: omit when N/A, persist 0/positive when shown
CURRENT_PRODUCTION_REPRODUCTION.FAIL_POINT: formFieldsForCategory.showStock=false → payload stock:0 → Product.stock wiped; owner could not restock

ROOT_CAUSE: Owner edit always uses MarketplaceOfferForm. showStock was gated on a CREATE taxonomy whitelist and DESIGN was classified as a service. Save sent stock:0 whenever the field was hidden.
MAX_STOCK_PURPOSE: Optional original/ceiling. Not used for available-to-buy when stock is set (including 0).
RESERVATION_MODEL: StockReservation PENDING hold before Stripe (hold:{id}:{productId}), EXPIRED on TTL/unpaid, CONFIRMED on payment then atomic decrement
stock_semantics: A — remaining sellable units after paid decrement. 0 = sold out. Omitted PATCH does not change stock.
EDIT_FLOW: MarketplaceOfferForm PATCH /api/products/[id] (listing pencil also routes here)
PAID_ORDER_CANCEL_STOCK_RULE: No automatic restore — physical goods may already be used/prepared
SELLER_MANUAL_RESTOCK: Owner can set stock from 0 to N on the same listing id
PRODUCTION_E2E_RESULT: DB/reservation chain PASS against connected DATABASE_URL; logged-in production UI not re-run after this fix (not deployed in this turn)
